scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/domain && npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/database && npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/security
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/bot && npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/ops-cli && npm run build -w @fxvrlxss/dashboard
scripts.dev:dashboard: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @fxvrlxss/dashboard
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @fxvrlxss/bot
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
